name: Oneiro Life
description: Keeps the Oneiro organization alive: supervises the life process and records gateway lifecycle into OSTIS.

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the oneiro-ostis project. Defaults to this plugin's project.

pythonPath.description: Python executable used for the OSTIS recorder and the life process.

autostart.description: Start the life process with the gateway and restart it after a crash (bounded).

intervalSeconds.description: Pause between cycles inside a supervised run.

host.description: OSTIS machine host for the bridge.

port.description: OSTIS machine port for the bridge.

sessionId.description: Session id the gateway's own records carry in the graph.
